description: This header file declares functions, structures, and constants related to Multi-Link Device (MLD) management in a wireless LAN context, including operations for fetching and updating affiliated station information, managing MLD objects, and checking shared configurations.

methods.name: wld_apMld_areAllBssEnabled
methods.description: Checks if all BSSs in a given MLD unit are enabled.

methods.name: wld_apMld_fetchAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about an affiliated station within a specified MLD unit and MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getActiveApAffiliatedStaInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about an active affiliated station linked to a specific access point.

methods.name: wld_apMld_notifyChange
methods.description: Notifies the system of a change event in the MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getOrCreateDmObject
methods.description: Gets or creates a DM object for an MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_createAffiliatedAPObject
methods.description: Creates an object representing an affiliated access point for MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_deleteAffiliatedAPObjects
methods.description: Deletes all affiliated access point objects linked to a specified MLD link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_clearMld
methods.description: Clears or resets the specified MLD.

methods.name: wld_apMld_getMldfromObj
methods.description: Retrieves the MLD structure from a given object.

methods.name: wld_apMld_updateAffAP
methods.description: Updates the affiliated access point data for an MLD link.

methods.name: wld_apMld_updateDM
methods.description: Updates the DM configuration for a given SSID.

methods.name: wld_apMld_hasSharedConnectionConf
methods.description: Checks whether an access point link shares applicable SSID and security configurations with other links.
